 Right Arrow Entertainment Hayden Panettiere's mom says skipping daughter's funeral was 'probably for the best'
 Lesley Vogel claimed she once found 'an enormous bag' of prescription drugs with Brian Hickerson's name
 By
 Tracy Wright Fox News 
 Published
 November 19, 2026 4:18pm EST Comments

 Fox News chief correspondent Jonathan Hunt reports on actress Hayden Panettiere's death being ruled an accident due to toxic effects of fentanyl and other substances on 'The Story.'
 NEW You can now listen to Fox News articles!
 Hayden Panettiere 's mother, Lesley Vogel, admitted that despite receiving an invitation, she didn't attend her daughter's funeral in September.
 Vogel recalled the last time she spoke with Panettiere was in "September or October of 2025" and told Inside Edition they had texted prior to her death in August from an accidental overdose.
 Vogel, who also served as Panettiere's manager throughout her childhood, cited her rising stardom as the catalyst for their fractured relationship before claiming that her daughter's boyfriend, Brian Hickerson, tore them apart further.
 HAYDEN PANETTIERE’S MOM DISCLOSES HEARTBREAKING ULTIMATUM IN THEIR FINAL PHONE CALL BEFORE ACTRESS’S DEATH 
 Hayden Panettiere's mother, Lesley Vogel, claimed she hadn't spoken to her daughter for one year prior to her death in August. (FilmMagic) 
 When asked why she chose not to attend the services, Vogel said she was protecting her own peace and didn't want to "rock the boat."
 "I knew that some of the people there wanted to believe that I'm the horrible mother because Hayden was angry and made statements," Vogel said. "I just didn't want to rock the boat, either. It was probably for the best."
 Panettiere had an on-again, off-again relationship with Hickerson in the years before her death at 36. Panettiere and Hickerson reportedly met through mutual friends in 2018, shortly after her split from Wladimir Klitschko .
 "We did spend a tremendous amount of time together up until the age of about 16," Vogel said. "Then, once she became the face of this major hit TV series, 'Heroes,' that's when things started to change."
 HAYDEN PANETTIERE'S ON-AND-OFF BOYFRIEND BRIAN HICKERSON BREAKS SILENCE AFTER STAR'S DEATH 
 The former couple's relationship was marked by highly public legal troubles . Hickerson was first charged with domestic violence against Panettiere in 2019.
 Brian Hickerson had been arrested multiple times on domestic violence charges. (Gotpap/Bauer-Griffin) 
 He was arrested again in 2020 on eight felony domestic violence charges, including felony charges of corporal injury on a spouse/cohabitant, a felony charge of assault with a deadly weapon and a misdemeanor charge of battery on a spouse/cohabitant.
 In 2021, he was sentenced after pleading no contest to two felony charges connected to the domestic violence involving Panettiere. The rest were dismissed due to the plea agreement.
 Three days before Panettiere's death, Hickerson appeared in Los Angeles court in an effort to have his felony charges reduced.
 LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS 
 "I had done everything to try to clean up her life in the end, and I thought we were making amazing progress. It was going very well," Vogel told the outlet. "And then, sadly, she allowed Brian to reel her back in. Hayden had clearly, somehow, let Brian take over many aspects of her life. I found an enormous bag of drugs ... prescription drugs (and) all had Brian Hickerson's name on it. All of them."
 Vogel said there was "no doubt in my mind" that Hickerson was responsible for her daughter's death.
 HAYDEN PANETTIERE’S BOYFRIEND’S BROTHER REVEALS WHAT HAPPENED INSIDE AIRBNB BEFORE ACTRESS'S DEATH 
 Lesley Vogel once served as Hayden Panettiere's manager. (Getty Images) 
 Hickerson has not been linked to Panettiere's death, and police have closed the investigation. The DEA is still reportedly investigating the case.
 Panettiere's death was ruled accidental in October, two months after the actress was found unresponsive at an apartment in Greenville, South Carolina.

 "Based on the Medical Examiner’s determination and the findings of the investigation, Hayden Panettiere’s death has been ruled accidental," the Greenville Police Department said in a statement.
 Hayden Panettiere died Aug. 16 from an accidental overdose. (Roy Rochlin/FilmMagic) 
 The "Heroes" star died from the toxic effects of fentanyl, 4-ANPP, alprazolam, methocarbamol and quetiapine, according to the Greenville County Coroner's Office.
 "On August 16, 2026, at approximately 1:51 PM, a 911 call was received regarding a reported cardiac arrest at 701 Easley Bridge Road in Greenville," the Greenville County Coroner's Office said in a release obtained by Fox News Digital.
 Hickerson and his brother, Zach, were with Panettiere at the time of her death, according to a police report.

 Hickerson reportedly traveled with the "Remember the Titans" actress from Los Angeles the day before she was found unresponsive at a Greenville, South Carolina, apartment complex on Aug. 16, according to TMZ .
 Brian Hickerson was the on-again, off-again partner of the late actress, Hayden Panattiere, who died Aug. 16. (Kat Ramirez for Fox News Digital)

 The two broke up briefly in 2022 but rekindled their romance the following year. Hickerson's brother confirmed to police Brian was in a relationship with the actress at the time of her death .
 Fox News Digital's Christina Dugan Ramirez contributed to this report.
